definitions.gloss: patterned item; item with a printed design
definitions.explanation: Clothing, fabric, or other items that have a pattern or design on them, as opposed to solid colors. Commonly used in fashion and textile contexts.

examples.japanese: {柄物|がらもの}のシャツが{好|す}きだ。
{柄物|がらもの}と{無地|むじ}を{組|く}み{合|あ}わせるとおしゃれだ。
examples.english: Combining patterned and solid-color items looks stylish.

examples.japanese: {柄物|がらもの}どうしを{合|あ}わせるのは{難|むずか}しいが、{上手|うま}くいくと{個性的|こせいてき}になる。
examples.english: Pairing patterned items together is difficult, but when done well it looks unique.

notes:
{柄|がら} means 'pattern' or 'design,' and {物|もの} means 'thing' or 'item.' {柄物|がらもの} is used in fashion and shopping to describe anything with a printed pattern — stripes, florals, checks, etc. It contrasts with {無地|むじ} (solid color, plain).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {柄物|がらもの}のスカート (patterned skirt)
- {柄物|がらもの}と{無地|むじ} (patterned and plain)
- {柄物|がらもの}を{着|き}る (to wear something patterned)
- {派手|はで}な{柄物|がらもの} (a boldly patterned item)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {無地|むじ} — solid color, plain (the opposite of {柄物|がらもの})
- {柄|がら} — pattern, design (the pattern itself, not the item)
- プリント — print (loanword; often used for specific printed designs on clothing)
